video_title: Did Wemby show too much emotion after winning the Western Conference Finals?! 😬 | Get Up

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on Victor Wembanyama's emotional reaction to Western Conference Finals win
quotes.excerpt: He got 4 more games to try to get. You gotta go through the Finals now.
quotes.quote: The alien got to go through some heartache to be able to tell the fairy tale Hallmark card story. He got to go through some. He was crying in the Western Conference Finals. That was too emotional for me. He got 4 more games to try to get. You gotta go through the Finals now. You still got to be even-keeled right here. That trophy, that ain't what we. That's cool, yeah we beat them, cool. But I got a whole another sight in this up here. It's going to take my energy to run up this hill. I can't be. That was how bad they wanted to beat OKC.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama and the Spurs struggling to process their emotional Western Conference Finals victory
quotes.excerpt: He and the team were having difficulty getting over that emotional victory.
quotes.quote: I thought the most interesting and raw thing he said yesterday in front of the media was he and the team were having difficulty getting over that emotional victory, not just getting to the Finals, but beating their rival, the Oklahoma City Thunder, who they've been focused on for the last year. He's like, yesterday afternoon, he's like, look, we got 30 hours left to try to get back down to earth.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Vincent Goodwill on the emotional release required for the Spurs after beating the Thunder
quotes.excerpt: The emotion that was required required a release like that, whether it was joy or relief.
quotes.quote: With the Spurs and Thunder, that series was in the balance until the final three or four minutes. So the emotion that was required required a release like that, whether it was joy or relief. I'm not worried about how the Spurs are going to show up tonight.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt on the Knicks' business-like approach to the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: They understand that the job is not done either and the unique opportunity that they have.
quotes.quote: They understand that the job is not done either and the unique opportunity that they have. I don't think any player in the league would say you got to get Wemby while he's young. But that's a very real thing in terms of the Knicks having an opportunity in front of them. They've gotten to the Finals, which in and of itself is not something that you can take for granted. This is going to be a big series for Carl-Anthony Towns. And I'm not saying that he alone can deter or slow or stop Victor Wembanyama, but it is going to be a big series for him.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on Mitchell Robinson's injury and status for Game 1
quotes.excerpt: He broke his hand. This injury to this part of the hand is frequently known as the boxer's fracture.
quotes.quote: The Knicks had to so to speak show their hand yesterday and when they filed their injury report, it was not the pinky of Mitchell Robinson that they announced had been broken. It was the metacarpal, which is the hand. He broke his hand. This injury to this part of the hand is frequently known as the boxer's fracture. I'll let you figure out why it's called the boxer's fracture. Mitchell Robinson was not available to the media yesterday to speak about it. However, more importantly than all that, he was available to the media to watch him practice and we saw him with a wrap on his hand, not just his finger, but his hand, and he looked like he was okay.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on the Knicks' defensive challenges against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks ain't seen this type of defense right here. They ain't seen this San Antonio.
quotes.quote: I don't want to give fools gold. I'm going to be really honest. The Knicks ain't seen this type of defense right here. They ain't seen this San Antonio. And they ain't seen this type of Wemby. This is a different Wemby. This is a different Wemby from two months ago. Are you watching how Castle, Vassell, how all the guards are guarding? The guards are, they got somebody for Brunson.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Knicks' ability to exploit Spurs' defensive weaknesses
quotes.excerpt: They exploited Philly and Cleveland's weaknesses defensively. They found the weakest link.
quotes.quote: They didn't just barely squeak by Philly and Cleveland, they blew them out. But they exploited Philly and Cleveland's weaknesses defensively. They found the weakest link, they manipulated their systems to make sure Brunson was on the weakest perimeter player, and then he feasted on them. There is no weak link in the Spurs defense. So there will be a culture shock tonight when they face the Spurs. But the Knicks know that. The Knicks are going to be prepared for that.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Vincent Goodwill on the Knicks' offensive strategy and the Spurs' defensive diversity
quotes.excerpt: Isaiah Hartenstein and Carl-Anthony Towns are two totally different animals that you have to look out for.
quotes.quote: I wonder if they go back to Carl-Anthony Towns being a hub of the offense. Basically what this comes down to to me guys, is forcing the opponent to do something that is not in the game plan. There are no perfect teams in the NBA, but there are teams who can exploit these flaws. Whether that's Steph Castle guarding Jalen Brunson, whether that's Victor Wembanyama sitting on Josh Hart and playing basically center field. I'm interested into seeing how Game 1 is going to play. These two teams don't know each other. Isaiah Hartenstein and Carl-Anthony Towns are two totally different animals that you have to look out for from that center position.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt on the Knicks' scoring depth and team performance
quotes.excerpt: The emergence of Mikal Bridges and OG Anunoby as consistent scorers has been a thing.
quotes.quote: There have been flashes of what you saw during the regular season, for example Game 1 versus Cleveland, but largely there are so many more guys scoring consistently and efficiently. Like this team is flirting with high 40s in terms of their three-point shooting as a unit. The emergence of Mikal Bridges and OG Anunoby as consistent scorers has been a thing. That's been fantastic for this Knicks squad.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on Mike Brown's tactical adjustments for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: When Josh Hart struggled from three-point range, he went to Landry Shamet, spread his whole team out.
quotes.quote: Mike Brown has some options. And we saw in the last series against Cleveland, when Josh Hart struggled from three-point range, he went to Landry Shamet, spread his whole team out. That's when they made that giant comeback in Game 1. They went to their all-out offense and attack that way. If that is not working, they can go to a bigger offense where they put Mitchell Robinson next to Carl-Anthony Towns. So I think the Spurs overall have more depth, but the Knicks can show different looks and go to different packages that I think we've already seen them have success with in the postseason.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Vincent Goodwill's prediction for the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I think we are going to see a coronation of Big Vic in seven games, man.
quotes.quote: This is a pick 'em series. And I will tell Knicks fans this because they think I hate them. I picked you to sweep Cleveland, I picked you to sweep Philadelphia. You ain't sweeping San Antonio and I don't think you're winning the series. I think we are going to see a coronation of Big Vic in seven games, man. This is just an irresistible force. He could have some lessons to learn, but San Antonio has shown they learn lessons really quickly.
